name: Sustained dialogue

shots.title: Waiting Beside the Covered Telescope
shots.sourceExcerpt:
## INT. OBSERVATORY - DAWN

Two astronomers wait beside a covered telescope. The younger keeps reaching for the cover; the older steadies her hand.
shots.description: Opening composition: a wide, low-angle frame of the observatory interior in pale pre-dawn light. The covered telescope dominates the center, and the two astronomers stand small beside it, the older on frame left and the younger on frame right. The camera slowly dollies forward as the younger astronomer reaches toward the cover. The older astronomer gently places a hand over hers and lowers it. The younger reaches again, and again the older steadies her hand. Ending composition: a medium-wide two-shot at waist height, both figures in profile with the cover between them and their joined hands at center frame.
shots.atmosphere: Hushed, expectant pre-dawn stillness; cool blue-grey light and deep shadows around the instrument.
shots.music: A sparse, sustained low string tone, barely audible.

shots.title: Let It Be Something You Do Not Understand
shots.sourceExcerpt:
### OLDER

When you look through there, you will want to give it a name. Wait. Let it be something you do not understand for a moment.
shots.description: Opening composition: a clearly distinct close-up over the younger astronomer's shoulder, centered on the older astronomer's face, which is softly lit by the cool dawn light. Her hand is still resting on the younger's hand at the lower edge of the frame. She speaks calmly and deliberately. On 'Wait,' the camera pushes in very slowly. She holds the younger's gaze through the final line. Ending composition: a tight close-up of the older astronomer, eyes steady, looking toward frame right at the younger.

dialogue.speaker: OLDER
dialogue.text: When you look through there, you will want to give it a name. Wait. Let it be something you do not understand for a moment.

shots.music: The low tone continues and is joined by a faint, slow piano note.

shots.title: And If It Disappears?
shots.description: Opening composition: a reverse close-up of the younger astronomer, framed slightly off-center facing frame left toward the older, with the edge of the telescope cover soft in the background. She glances briefly toward the cover, then back to the older astronomer as she asks her question. The camera is static. Ending composition: the younger's face in close-up, eyes searching, waiting for an answer.
shots.atmosphere: A small, vulnerable uncertainty in the quiet room.
shots.music: The music holds on a single suspended note.

shots.title: Seen It Together
shots.sourceExcerpt:
### OLDER

Then we will have seen it together.
shots.description: Opening composition: a medium two-shot from the side, both astronomers in profile facing each other at chest height, with the older on frame left and the younger on frame right, matching the established geography. The older astronomer answers gently. As she finishes, both turn toward the covered telescope, and each places a hand on the cover. The camera is static. Ending composition: both astronomers looking at the cover, hands resting on it together.

dialogue.speaker: OLDER
dialogue.text: Then we will have seen it together.

shots.music: The piano resolves into a warmer chord.

shots.title: Lifting the Cover at Dawn
shots.sourceExcerpt: They lift the cover together as the room begins to brighten.
shots.description: Opening composition: a high wide angle looking down across the telescope, with both astronomers on either side of it gripping the cover, distinctly separate from the preceding eye-level two-shot. Together they slowly lift the cover away from the telescope. As they do, the room begins to brighten, and warmer light gradually spreads across the floor, the instrument and their faces. The camera cranes down and eases in toward the uncovered telescope. Ending composition: a medium-wide frame of the telescope, now uncovered, with the two astronomers standing beside it in the brightening room.
shots.atmosphere: Quiet awe as cool blue gives way to rising warm dawn light.
shots.music: Strings swell softly and gently, then hold as the light grows.
